mapper.sql: id, user_id, username, request_url, request_method, request_params, error_message, error_stack, status_code, ip_address, user_agent, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO error_logs (user_id, username, request_url, request_method, request_params, error_message, error_stack, status_code, ip_address, user_agent, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{requestUrl}, #{requestMethod}, #{requestParams}, #{errorMessage}, #{errorStack}, #{statusCode}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM error_logs WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
